dual_pathway.summary: Two branches read the same window through two lenses - a fast one over the last few bars at full resolution and a slow one over the whole window sampled every few bars - and a gated fusion layer decides how much each one drives the call.
dual_pathway.implementationNote: Each pathway is a forward-only gated recurrent unit; the fast view is the last fast_window_bars bars, the slow view every slow_stride-th bar counted back from the last bar, so both views end on the bar being predicted. Their final states are concatenated, gated by a learned logistic gate and read by a fusion perceptron. Fusion is once, at the head (no lateral connections); both pathways share one width.

sequence_length.label: Sequence length (bars)
sequence_length.description: How many past bars the window holds for one prediction; the slow pathway reads it sampled every slow_stride bars, the fast pathway its last fast_window_bars bars.

fast_window_bars.label: Fast pathway window (bars)
fast_window_bars.description: How many of the most recent bars the fast pathway reads at full resolution. A value above the sequence length is clamped to the sequence length.

slow_stride.label: Slow pathway stride (bars)
slow_stride.description: The slow pathway reads every this-many-th bar of the whole window, counted back from the last bar, so its view is coarser but spans the full window.

pathway_hidden_size.label: Pathway hidden size
pathway_hidden_size.description: How many units each pathway's gated recurrent unit keeps as its state.

fusion_hidden_size.label: Fusion hidden size
fusion_hidden_size.description: How many units the fusion layer has after the two pathways' gated states are joined; the head reads this vector.

dropout.label: Dropout
dropout.description: The share of units switched off at random during training, on each pathway's final state before fusion and on the fused vector.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: How big a step each weight update takes.

weight_decay.label: Weight decay
weight_decay.description: A pull of every weight toward zero, which keeps the network simple.

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.description: How many bars one weight update averages over.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.description: How many passes over the training bars at most.

patience.label: Patience (epochs)
patience.description: Stop after this many epochs without a better validation loss; the best epoch is kept.
